newsitem.title: USA: Belco Turner well yields 4,800 bpd oil.
newsitem.headline: Belco Turner well yields 4,800 bpd oil.

text.p: Belco Oil & Gas Corp said Tuesday the Turner ET AL 21 No.1 well, which was drilled 17,000 feet deep and horizontally for 3,850 feet, flowed at 4,800 barrels per day of oil in initial tests.

The well, in the Austin Chalk formation in St. Landry Parish, La., also yielded 6 million cubic feet of gas per day at a flowing tubing pressure of 6,800 pounds per square inch on a 20/64-inch choke with no water production.

Belco said it has a 100-percent working interest in this well until payout and a 77.5-percent working interest afterward. The company holds oil and gas leases covering about 38,480 gross and 29,060 net acres on this prospect.

In a second discovery located in Avoyelles Parish, Louisiana, 13.5 miles from the first well, Belco re-entered the Roy O. Martin 'A' No.1 well, a previously drilled Tuscaloosa test and drilled 15,333 feet deep and horizontally for 3,900 feet.

On initial completion tests, the well flowed at a rate of 2,500 barrels of oil per day and 2.7 million cubic feet of gas per day at a flowing tubing pressure of 1,000 pounds per square inch on a 1/2-inch choke with no formation water produced.

Belco said it has a 100-percent working interest in this well until payout and a 75-percent working interest afterward. The company has interests in oil and gas leases or options for about 42,310 gross and 34,880 net acres in this prospect .

The company said it anticipates an early start to production and is planning offset drilling in the near future. "These prospects were drilled along a trend in which the company has acquired control of over 250,000 net acres, a position which holds the potential for substantial growth in the company's production and reserves," said Robert Belfer, chairman and chief executive.
